result.title: OpenAI is FINALLY Releasing Hardware
result.description:
Mark your calendars for July 15th! 

OpenAI is officially releasing its first-ever hardware product this month. It’s a physical, programmable macro pad built specifically for developers to use with Codex and created in partnership with mechanical keyboard maker @worklouder

Reportedly based on Work Louder’s popular Creator Micro 2, this device sits next to your keyboard to give you tactile control and shortcuts for your AI coding workflows. Instead of repeatedly typing out prompts, you can use dedicated shortcut buttons to start or steer coding tasks, approve code changes, review diffs and debug.

result.title: AI Can FINALLY Edit Videos For You
result.description:
Imagine typing "edit this for me" and letting AI handle your entire video timeline. 🤯

That's the promise behind Palmier (not sponsored), a new AI video editor powered by Claude. From organizing media and trimming clips to generating missing B-roll on the fly, it’s designed to automate the manual side of editing.

At $29/month for around 3 to 7 minutes of generated video, it's not the cheapest product to use, especially when you factor in potential revisions. BUT it's still probably cheaper than a professional video editor. 

I haven’t run any footage through it yet, but I'm curious to see how it performs and if it's worth it. Let me know in the comments if you'd want to see a hands-on test 👇🏻

#ai #videoediting #contentcreator
